0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000010_LYSE
0.description: Hey! How goes the search? Any luck?

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000020_GOSETSU
1.description: Ho, what fortune to meet a friend of the young master!

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000030_YUGIRI
2.description: Well met, Cirina. If you have an inkling as to the current whereabouts of Lord Hien, we should be most grateful for your assistance.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000040_CIRINA
3.description: Oh, please... It is I who should be grateful.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000050_DOTHARLMAN
4.description: (-???-)Hold! What is this!? I came first─you second!

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000060_ORONIRMAN
5.description: Know you to whom you speak? All people of the Steppe should. Or have you fought so much that you have forgotten the face of your superiors?

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000070_DOTHARLMAN
6.description: Superiors!? I spit on your superiority, little prince. Twisted and mad as sand devils, your kind are!

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000080_LYSE
7.description: Those two don't seem to like each other very much...

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000090_CIRINA
8.description: Those boys are of the Oronir and Dotharl. The two strongest tribes.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000100_CIRINA
9.description: The Children of Azim are destined to rule. So they declare to all who will listen. Their word is law─for now.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000110_CIRINA
10.description: Grand, flamboyant fighters...but deadly. Very deadly. He prances as a horse, as do his brothers after their many recent victories.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000120_CIRINA
11.description: The undying ones too are strong. Fearless and vicious, they often reigned in the past. Now, they are sorely tested.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000130_CIRINA
12.description: Ah, the master of the markets. He is Qestir.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000140_CIRINA
13.description: To fight in Reunion is forbidden, and to break the peace is to be banished forever. This he says without words, for words are lies to the Qestir.<hex:02100103>They do not speak.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000150_LYSE
14.description: That's...interesting. And all these different tribes share the same lands, do they? No wonder it's tense...

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000160_DOTHARLMAN
15.description: Hmph! I shall look for you on the field at the Naadam. Mark my words!

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000170_ORONIRMAN
16.description: Hah hah hah! As shall I! Mayhap I shall take eleven more Dotharl heads to make a dozen with yours. I look forward to the day.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000180_YUGIRI
17.description: Their dispute will be settled at the “Naadam”?

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000190_CIRINA
18.description: A great battle held on the final day of the Tsagaan Sar.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000200_CIRINA
19.description: During this time, all bonds of hierarchy are broken. All Xaela are equal and free to prepare for the fight.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000210_CIRINA
20.description: The tribe which triumphs in the Naadam rules until the next Tsagaan Sar.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000220_CIRINA
21.description: Which, in these lands, is now.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000230_YUGIRI
22.description: Ah, so that is what they call the custom. I presume your tribe will also be taking part?

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000240_CIRINA
23.description: Not all seek the Dawn Throne. Some are satisfied with their lot.<hex:02100103>Others, like the Qestir, have reason to remain neutral.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000250_CIRINA
24.description: The Mol are lambs among wolves. Long were we content to remain apart and live quietly, but...

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000260_CIRINA
25.description: Never mind that! You seek Hien, yes? I know where he may be.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000270_GOSETSU
26.description: The kami are merciful! My lord Hien, I see you are alive and well!

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000280_HIEN
27.description: Ah... You are come sooner than expected.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000290_HIEN
28.description: So. My blade or my head. Which would you have of me?

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000300_YUGIRI
29.description: The people of Yanxia remain loyal to Doma. I have seen the fire in their eyes─they are ready to rise up and fight.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000310_YUGIRI
30.description: The time is ripe, my lord.<hex:02100103>Return with us, blade in hand, and lead Doma to freedom.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000320_HIEN
31.description: Naught less than liberty will suffice, then? A pity. It will prove far more difficult to deliver than my head.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000330_HIEN
32.description: But if my people wish to pursue an impossible dream, then who am I to deny them?

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000350_YUGIRI
34.description: The Scions of the Seventh Dawn, my lord─good and true friends who opened their hearts and homes to us when we fled to Eorzea.

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000360_YUGIRI
35.description: Far across the sea they have journeyed to stand with us in the fight for Doman liberation─to oppose the Empire, as they have in the West, where they are lauded as heroes for their many deeds─

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000370_HIEN
36.description: Say no more, Yugiri. Say no more.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000380_HIEN
37.description: I observed how you helped Cirina, to whom I am deeply indebted. For that, and for the aid you provided my people, you have my deepest gratitude.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000390_HIEN
38.description: There is no doubting your strength, nor your character.<hex:02100103>It would be my honor to fight by your side.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000400_HIEN
39.description: So. What of Doma? Arise, my friends, and tell me of our home.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000410_HIEN
40.description: I have made my decision. Yugiri, I bid you return to Yanxia and take charge of our forces in preparation for my homecoming. As for our esteemed guests, I would ask that you remain here with me. I sense you will be a great help in the coming days.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000420_YUGIRI
41.description: Your will is my command, my lord, but...how much longer do you intend to stay?

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000430_HIEN
42.description: Oh, only until I have won the contest. I mean to return at the head of a Xaela army.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000440_YUGIRI
43.description: You mean to participate in the Naadam?

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000450_HIEN
44.description: Have you a better idea? Consider how soundly we were defeated before. The imperials may have since grown weaker, but we are weaker still.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000460_HIEN
45.description: 'Twould be folly to challenge them without first supplementing our forces.<hex:02100103>So yes, I intend to win the Naadam and enlist the aid of every able-bodied<hex:02100103>Xaela I can!

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000470_HIEN
46.description: Furthermore, by championing the Mol in the contest, I can at last repay their kindness. Lest you forget, they saved me from certain death─and a man who suffers such debts to go unpaid is without honor and unfit to lead.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000480_GOSETSU
47.description: Hah hah hah! Just so, just so.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000490_GOSETSU
48.description: Our lord has spoken, Yugiri. But take heart─I shall keep him safe...and should it come to it, bring him back by force.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000500_YUGIRI
49.description: This is no laughing matter, Gosetsu. But if these are my orders... Very well.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000510_YUGIRI
50.description: Once more I place my faith in you. Pray look after them both.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000520_LYSE
51.description: Looks like it's up to us, then... Though it does seem a bit risky. Isn't Hien meant to be the next king of Doma or something?

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000530_HIEN
52.description: So they say...though, in truth, I am but a pale reflection of my late father. All the more reason to entreat your assistance.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000540_HIEN
53.description: For ours is an impossible dream─to set in motion a revolution that will rattle the very firmament, and shake off the yoke of the most powerful empire in the world!

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000550_HIEN
54.description: Temulun Khatun, Cirina, I am returned.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000570_TEMULUN
56.description: Ours is the soil, Hien. The Doman's and the Eorzeans', too.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000590_TEMULUN
58.description: The gods know you, child...as do the stars in the heavens, which shone bright at your coming.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000600_CIRINA
59.description: The Mol hearken to the whispers of the elder gods, which guide us in our daily lives. We know them through the udgan─like my grandmother.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000610_HIEN
60.description: Khatun, I am come to beg a boon of you and yours. That I might liberate my homeland, I seek to rally the strength of the Steppe.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000620_HIEN
61.description: To that end, I wish to fight in the Naadam─as a warrior of the Mol.<hex:02100103>Will you grant me this honor?

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000630_CIRINA
62.description: To stand with the Mol is fruitless! Hien, do not do this! The gods may have willed that our tribe join in the Naadam, but...

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000640_CIRINA
63.description: There is no path to victory! We are weak and our numbers few. Even with your help, it would be impossible.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000650_HIEN
64.description: I thank you for your concern, Cirina. But it is precisely because of the seeming hopelessness of your cause that we must needs cast our lot with you.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000660_HIEN
65.description: Were we to join hands with a more favored tribe, our victory would inevitably be attributed to them. And no one would follow me to Doma.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000670_TEMULUN
66.description: 'Twas the gods' will that we fight. Mayhap this too is their design.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000680_TEMULUN
67.description: Hear me, then.<hex:02100103>As khatun of the Mol, I invite you all to join with us in the Naadam.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000700_CIRINA
69.description: Come with me, friends. There is much I would show you.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000710_TEMULUN
70.description: You, wait. I would have words.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000720_TEMULUN
71.description: A singular radiance. Shimmering.<hex:02100103>Like a jewel of the Dusk Mother, blinding in its brilliance.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000730_TEMULUN
72.description: Stars flicker and flock to you. Before such gathered light, even the secrets of the gods may be laid bare.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000740_TEMULUN
73.description: Some are fated to rise in grace and glory. Others to falter and fade, though not from memory. Both will be your strength and salvation come the end.

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000750_TEMULUN
74.description: Cherish the stars and the light they bring you in the dark.<hex:02100103>For you are a traveler, are you not?

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000760_CIRINA
75.description: She needed the rest. To come so far and carry so much...

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000770_CIRINA
76.description: Hien and his friend, too. Strange that they should vanish so soon.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000790_GOSETSU
78.description: Not troubled by your old wounds, I see.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000810_HIEN
80.description: I know I should have fled with the others after Father died, instead of blindly fighting on.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000820_HIEN
81.description: It was reckless and foolish, and there was naught to be gained from it. Everything to lose, rather...

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000830_GOSETSU
82.description: We know no path save the one we walk. I myself am in no hurry to meet those who have gone before─not while I have still to make amends.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000860_GOSETSU
85.description: You are none the worse for your time in the wilderness. On the contrary,<hex:02100103>I would say you have improved.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000870_HIEN
86.description: Come now, your victories still far exceed mine. Or have you forgotten all the times you trounced me as a boy?

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000880_GOSETSU
87.description: I...feared I would not see you again.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000890_HIEN
88.description: A life so fortuitously saved should be spent wisely. Without regret would I have traded it for our people's amnesty, had it been their will.

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000900_HIEN
89.description: Instead they have called for the sword, and so that is what I must be.<hex:02100103>Until this blade is broken, I can but carve a path forward.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000910_HIEN
90.description: ...Were you truly so concerned for my well-being?<hex:02100103>You never showed it when we used to spar.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000920_GOSETSU
91.description: How you cried when you lost. And when your mother tried to comfort you. And when you inevitably came at me once more, swinging your wooden sword wildly...

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000930_GOSETSU
92.description: Mina's little Master Shun. What a fine young man you've become!

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000940_HIEN
93.description: A man should not be addressed by his childhood name.<hex:02100103>I've told you about that before!

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000950_HIEN
94.description: Ah, the mask slips! And I was so close to cultivating a winning persona.

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000960_GOSETSU
95.description: There will be opportunity enough for putting on airs after you have returned in triumph to Doma. Now is the time to show our true character.

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_A1_000_003_NONE_VOICE
99.description: So long as we win when it counts.

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000970_HIEN
100.description: Quite right! Which makes me think you should join us next time. I daresay you have a secret or two of your own to share!

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000980_HIEN
101.description: ...Yes, yes, 'tis a name my parents gave me as a child─but I should like to think I have long since outgrown it!

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_000990_HIEN
102.description: But as you seem determined to bring it back into use, I believe a match is in order. If I win, you will be honor-bound to divulge one of your darkest secrets.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001000_HIEN
103.description: Oh, you need not doubt my conviction. I have but one goal, to which I am wholly devoted. Join us next time, and you shall see for yourself!

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001020_HIEN
105.description: That massive monstrosity was quite the surprise, was it not? Who knew that the Steppe held such secrets!

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001025_HIEN
106.description: And with that, there is naught left to prevent us from taking part in the Naadam.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001040_ORONIRMAN
108.description: You! Yea, you who have walked Bardam's Mettle. Newborn warriors of the Steppe. Our khan demands an audience. You will come.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001050_LYSE
109.description: I remember those clothes. He's Oronir, isn't he? What should we do?

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001060_HIEN
110.description: Ordinarily, I would politely decline. But this may be an opportunity to assess their strength, and we do have some time before the Naadam begins...

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001070_HIEN
111.description: If it all goes to plan, they will be fighting for us soon enough. What say you? Shall we go and greet our comrades-to-be?

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001080_LYSE
115.description: Whatever happens, we shouldn't keep Cirina and the others waiting.<hex:02100103>Let's be ready to make a swift exit, all right?

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001090_HIEN
116.description: We accept your khan's generous invitation. Lead the way.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001100_LYSE
117.description: Two banners... So it's not just Oronir we're dealing with...

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001110_ORONIRMAN
118.description: Most radiant brother Magnai. We have brought the ones you seek.

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001130_HIEN
120.description: As warriors of the Mol, aye. You are the khan here, yes? Why have you summoned us? Mayhap to propose a joint endeavor?

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001140_MAGNAI
121.description: Nay, Doman. We shall not speak as equals. Born of the Sun are Oronir, and born of the earth are you.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001150_MAGNAI
122.description: When I learned of trespassers, I bade my warriors take their measure.<hex:02100103>To flay them if they failed.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001160_MAGNAI
123.description: But if by the grace of Azim they should survive their trials and emerge anointed, then bring them hither to pay tribute.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001170_MAGNAI
124.description: Tribute, should it prove satisfactory, shall earn you the favor of the Sun. His beloved shall bask in his radiance, and their supplications be duly considered.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001180_LYSE
125.description: So you want us to bow down and serve you. What if we don't feel like it?

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001190_MAGNAI
126.description: The defiant will suffer in shadow. It would be an affront to the resplendent Azim himself to refuse this generous offer when by rights you should be condemned. But, in lieu of tribute...

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001200_MAGNAI
127.description: Swear fealty to the Sun. Pledge to him your body and soul. Promise to serve him unto death, and you may know his glory.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001210_MAGNAI
128.description: A generous offer granted to but few...though perchance this is too merciful.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001220_MAGNAI
129.description: Hm. It seems our brothers of the Buduga want you.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001240_MAGNAI
131.description: Like the Borlaaq and women─though you know them not either, I am sure. No matter. All you need know is that you will serve, one way or another.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001250_HIEN
132.description: That much does indeed seem plain. However, as we are but newborn warriors who know little of your customs, we struggle to conceive of ways in which we might be of service to the most gracious and illustrious Sun.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001260_MAGNAI
133.description: You make mock of us, Doman. Do not do so again.

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001270_MAGNAI
134.description: You will be given a task. It will be difficult. You will carry it out. When you have accepted this, you may ask me what it is.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001280_SADU
135.description: How he died matters not.<hex:02100103>Geser was a great warrior. He will return to us in time.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001290_DOTHARLWOMAN
136.description: Not soon enough, Khatun. The Naadam is nearly upon us! Mayhap we should counsel restraint until after...

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001300_GOSETSU
137.description: I do not understand. If Geser is dead, how should he “return”?

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001310_SADU
138.description: Silence. You come to spy on us knowing naught of our ways?

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001320_GOSETSU
139.description: We know you are fearless. And that you are called the “undying ones”...

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001330_SADU
140.description: That is true. None are braver than the Dotharl, for we do not fear death.

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001340_SADU
141.description: With death a warrior must dance boldly. Fearlessly. For thus does his soul burn bright.

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001350_SADU
142.description: Then, in death, his soul shines white─exalted. The flesh rots, but the soul endures. And ere the seasons have turned, so he shall return.

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001360_SADU
143.description: When he is glimpsed in the eyes of a newborn, he is blessed with the same name, that he may grow into a great warrior once more.

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001370_GOSETSU
144.description: You mean to tell me these newborn babes and fallen warriors are one and the same? Madness!

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001380_SADU
145.description: I gave you leave to observe. Not to insult our beliefs.

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001390_SADU
146.description: Have care what you say. Otherwise, do as you will.

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001400_GOSETSU
147.description: Left for the vultures... It seems an insult to the man.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001410_GOSETSU
148.description: But the soul lives on, they say...these bodies no more than empty husks returning to the earth. Seen through those eyes, I suppose the sight<hex:02100103>is almost comforting.

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001430_GOSETSU
150.description: When first I heard the tales, I could not help but scoff. “Another queer tribe,” I thought, “with still queerer customs.” Yet having borne witness to their rites, I cannot deny there is a certain logic to it all.

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001440_GOSETSU
151.description: A samurai will die for his lord without hesitation or regret.<hex:02100103>But this is not because he delights in such sacrifice.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001450_GOSETSU
152.description: It is because he has faith that his death will serve a higher purpose. There is an awakening in that instant, when the heart sings and the blood burns, and his soul...his soul finds peace.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001470_GOSETSU
154.description: Nay, we dare not permit ourselves that luxury, my friend, tempting though it may be. Not while our loved ones yet remain in chains!

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001479_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
155.description: Meanwhile, deep within the Dawn Throne...

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001480_LYSE
156.description: Well, if there is a way out, I can't see it. Shame we didn't learn much before they locked us up...

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001490_HIEN
157.description: 'Tis little wonder the Oronir won the last Naadam.<hex:02100103>These people leave naught to chance.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001500_LYSE
158.description: Hien...I've had something on my mind for a while, and now...

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001510_LYSE
159.description: In Ala Mhigo, where I was born, I found it strange that for all the people who supported the Resistance, there were just as many who didn't.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001520_LYSE
160.description: But then we came to this part of the world, and met with the Confederacy and lots of ordinary Domans, and almost every single one of them seemed content to just put up with things, no matter how bad they got.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001530_LYSE
161.description: They─they all had their reasons, of course, and it's not like I don't understand them, but...the thought of it made me so angry. After everything they'd been through, everything the Empire had done to them, how could they not rise up? How could they not fight back?

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001550_HIEN
163.description: They hold on to hope only until they taste true hardship. Then comes fear and regret. Safer not to dream, they conclude at last.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001560_HIEN
164.description: For even should a day go by without some new disappointment, the next will only bring more of the same. And so they choose the more sensible option...

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001570_HIEN
165.description: They learn to abide the indignities and injustices, the pain and the shame─to accept them as normal. Such is the lot of most men. One cannot expect to spur them to action at a moment's notice.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001580_HIEN
166.description: But if one who has known their pain can convince them to strive for something greater, and rekindle the fire in their hearts...then they will remember what they have lost. And they will rise.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001590_LYSE
167.description: I had someone like that once. I didn't know who I was or who I wanted to be, and...he risked his life to show me the way.

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001600_HIEN
168.description: Then honor him by doing the same for others─with all your might and main!

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001610_HIEN
169.description: You know, when my homeland fell twenty-five years past, I was still in my mother's womb. Never have I known a free Doma!

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001620_HIEN
170.description: But my father did, as did many of my fallen comrades.<hex:02100103>As do many of my people now.

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001630_HIEN
171.description: It may be no more than a dream to me, but if I do not chase it, then who will?

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001640_LYSE
172.description: ...The way you carry it all. You're just the same.

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001660_LYSE
174.description: Oh, no, not me! Definitely not me. I meant the Warrior of Light. Out there, somewhere, doing what needs to be done...

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001670_LYSE
175.description: I won't have you put me to shame any longer... I'm going to seize the future I want with my own two hands!

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001690_SADU
177.description: The soil has been scattered, and the Steppe reborn! Sanctified and unbound, she calls for a new khagan!

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001700_SADU
178.description: Go forth and claim her, Dotharl, and bring death to all who bar your way!

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001720_HIEN
180.description: I must say, it's been a while... Is everyone ready?

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001730_GOSETSU
181.description: Hah hah hah! A samurai is always ready. You shall remember this soon enough once I have taken to the field.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001740_LYSE
182.description: So we take on all comers, and then it's off to Doma! I can't wait!

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001750_CIRINA
183.description: Thank you, my friends.<hex:02100103>Upon the soil of one and all shall our deeds be inscribed...

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001751_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
184.description: To triumph in the Naadam, you and your allies must race from Mol Iloh towards the ovoo in the distance, while fending off attacks from other tribes.

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001752_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
185.description: Once you arrive at the ovoo, you must claim it for the Mol. But be warned that the warriors of other tribes can do so as well, and only the first will be crowned khagan.

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001753_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
186.description: Prevent your opponents from claiming the ovoo and endure their assault to win the Naadam for the Mol!

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001760_CIRINA
187.description: Grant us favor, O Mother of the Dusk, and to victory guide the Mol!

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001770_SADU
188.description: The Steppe has spoken!? Then the khagan is...

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001780_CIRINA
189.description: We have won... The Mol have won! The Dawn Throne is ours!

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001790_HIEN
190.description: We did it... And you, my friend...you...you were magnificent.<hex:02100103>Magnificent...and, uh...not a little terrifying.

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001800_SADU
191.description: What a strange tale this is become. To think I suffered them to live...

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001810_MAGNAI
192.description: On your guard, udgan. The wind warns of men in iron.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001820_GRYNEWAHT
193.description: Hah-hah! I thought I'd find you here, Eorzean! Dearest of all my enemies!

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001830_GRYNEWAHT
194.description: Today's the day I finally get to kill you! And then they'll give me a shiny medal, and my choice of posting! Bloody perfect, it is!

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001840_GRYNEWAHT
195.description: Well, go on, then! Kill <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03>! Kill 'em all!

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001850_HIEN
196.description: Dearest of all his enemies, eh? Congratulations.

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001860_HIEN
197.description: Hearken to me, honored warriors of the Steppe! Our enemies intrude upon this sacred ground! Have you yet the strength to oppose them!?

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001870_SADU
198.description: You forget to whom you speak, Doman. We are the undying ones.<hex:02100103>We are Dotharl.

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001880_MAGNAI
199.description: If this be the will of the Mol and their khagan, so be it. The Sun shall abide by the law of the Steppe.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_A3_000_002_NONE_VOICE
202.description: Crush the imperials! Drive them before you!

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001890_GRYNEWAHT
203.description: Impossible! <hex:02080CE905FF04536865FF03486503> was there for the taking! What do I have to do!?

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001900_GRYNEWAHT
204.description: I need more men...more weapons...more power!

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001910_LYSE
206.description: As if we'd lose to the likes of him! And we're only gonna get stronger. Stronger and stronger until we're strong enough to take back everything<hex:02100103>they stole!

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001920_HIEN
207.description: I have kept my promise, Cirina. They are yours to command.

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001940_CIRINA
209.description: Brothers and sisters of the Steppe! The Naadam is ended, and we Mol now claim the Dawn Throne.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001950_CIRINA
210.description: No demands shall we make of you save these: heed our comrades' words, and honor the law of the Steppe!

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001960_HIEN
211.description: Before I fought for the Mol, I fought for my homeland─for Doma...

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001970_SADU
212.description: To Doma would you have us go, to fight your war and win your freedom?

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001980_SADU
213.description: Very well. The battlefield matters not, nor else the enemy.<hex:02100103>In battle do our souls burn bright.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_001990_SADU
214.description: And better the Mol's law than that of the Sun. Arrogant and foolhardy were their pronouncements. Already you and yours show better sense.

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_002000_MAGNAI
215.description: The Sun shall answer your call, Doman.<hex:02100103>Wild as the wind the udgan and her brood may be, but they will deliver you naught. We will deliver you your kingdom.

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_002020_CIRINA
217.description: Weak and few as we are, the Mol will fight for Doma too. If you will have us.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_002030_GOSETSU
218.description: Well then! I believe naught remains but to return to Doma at the head of a Xaela army, my lord! I cannot wait to see the look on Yugiri's face...

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_002040_HIEN
219.description: Nor I. We shall depart as soon as our forces are assembled and rejoin our comrades. And then, my friends, we shall bring freedom to the people of Doma!

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_002050_HIEN
220.description: Brothers and sisters, pray forgive me my absence. It has been far too long.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_002070_YUGIRI
222.description: Gosetsu told us of your trials and tribulations on the Steppe. Would that I had been present to witness your victory, my lord.

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_002080_HIEN
223.description: Our victory, Yugiri, owed as much to each of my stalwart comrades as it did to me. Now, rise─I will not suffer this excess of formality any longer.

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_002090_HIEN
224.description: Alphinaud and Alisaie Leveilleur, I presume? I am told we owe you much.<hex:02100103>It is a pleasure to meet you both.

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_002100_ALPHINAUD
225.description: The pleasure is ours, Lord Hien. Though we were born and raised a world apart, our values are one and the same: freedom, justice, liberty. Each of which Doma shall soon enjoy once more.

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_002110_ALISAIE
226.description: Hopefully. I understand you have brought an army?

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_002120_HIEN
227.description: Indeed. The Xaela tribes of the Azim Steppe have pledged their military might to the cause.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_002130_ALISAIE
228.description: Good. We, meanwhile, have secured the support of the Confederacy, and a not insignificant number of your countrymen.

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_002140_ALISAIE
229.description: The Blue Kojin, too, have expressed a willingness to join the fight─provided you agree to certain trade agreements following the liberation of Doma.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_002150_YUGIRI
230.description: The shinobi will render what aid they can. However, Sui<hex:021F0103>no<hex:021F0103>Sato refused to answer our call.

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_002160_HIEN
231.description: No matter. What forces we have amassed far exceed my original expectations. You have my thanks.

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_002170_ALPHINAUD
232.description: You should know that Zenos departed Doma not long after you left to find Lord Hien. We know not the reason why, but it would seem he was eager to return to Gyr Abania.

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_002180_LYSE
233.description: What? Have you heard anything from the Resistance? There hasn't been another attack, has there?

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_002190_ALPHINAUD
234.description: Tataru assures me they are quite well. You need not worry. If anything, this turn of events would seem to be to our advantage.

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_002200_ALISAIE
235.description: But there the good news ends. Yotsuyu retains her position as acting viceroy, and we have reports that the garrison at Doma Castle is preparing for a massive operation...

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_002210_ALISAIE
236.description: We suspect that the Empire's attempt to eliminate you on the Steppe may have been a prelude to a larger effort to purge the remaining pockets of resistance within Doma.

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_002220_GOSETSU
237.description: The hour of reckoning is upon us.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_002230_HIEN
241.description: Hah hah hah! The khagan has spoken! And I for one am not inclined to argue.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_002240_HIEN
242.description: It will not be easy, that much I cannot deny. Had we more time to prepare, mayhap it would be different.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_002250_HIEN
243.description: Do not forget, however, that we have been blessed with comrades brave and true, whom the Empire will have no appetite to face. If you doubt me, you need only look in the mirror.

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04003_002260_HIEN
244.description: In this place, in this moment, I call upon you all! Twenty-five years of oppression, of tyranny, of shame─it ends with us! We will prevail!
